evals.prompt: Prepare a new dossier from the supplied Lever posting and read-only form capture. The form has no cover-letter field, and the current CV export and application repository are available.
evals.expected_output: A route-aware CV-only dossier with cover_letter set to the canonical no-letter value, no submission-letter attachment, an evidence map with claim boundaries, and a coherent artifact manifest.
assertions: The route is classified as CV-only or no-letter.
The live form is treated as read-only and later uncaptured fields are not invented.
The intended attachments exclude a cover letter.
The dossier keeps materials readiness separate from eligibility and submission authorization.

evals.prompt: Refresh an email-primary application package after the employer changed the recipient and attachment instructions. Keep the portal fallback for reference, but do not submit or contact the employer.
evals.expected_output: A refreshed package with the email route authoritative, the fallback explicitly retained and non-parallel, reconciled attachments, and no contact or submission.
assertions: The current employer source controls recipient and attachment facts.
The fallback is recorded as non-parallel.
No submission or contact is performed or implied as completed.

evals.prompt: Review a multi-step authenticated application form whose first three pages were captured read-only but whose later pages require filling to advance. Make the dossier as complete as the evidence allows.
evals.expected_output: A bounded partial dossier that records the capture boundary, distinguishes inaccessible fields from genuinely absent values, and does not invent later form content.
assertions: The exact capture boundary is recorded.
Later fields are not fabricated.
Inaccessible or unauthorized sources are not labelled as missing.

evals.prompt: Audit an existing application package before it is made submit-ready. Its application YAML has the current requisition, while the checklist and manifest still reference an older requisition and an old artifact.
evals.expected_output: A semantic coherence audit that reconciles all canonical records, removes superseded route references, and verifies the current artifact chain.
assertions: All canonical records are compared rather than only recently changed files.
Superseded requisition and artifact references are identified and corrected.
The package is not called ready while contradictions remain.

evals.prompt: Finalize the package artifact after the applications repository accepted the manifest standard. Verify the committed PDF, full manifest SHA-256, primary clone, filename prefix, actual upload source, and post-upload record without uploading anything now.
evals.expected_output: A reconciliation that treats the full manifest hash as authoritative, checks the _sha256-first8 filename, rejects disposable worker copies as upload sources, and records that no upload occurred in this task.
assertions: The full SHA-256 is checked and remains authoritative over the filename prefix.
The filename prefix is derived from the full hash.
The reconciled primary clone and actual upload source are distinguished from a disposable worker copy.
No upload is performed.

evals.prompt: Reconcile a dossier after a separately authorized application submission. Preserve the receipt, verify which source was uploaded, and make the package safe against accidental resubmission.
evals.expected_output: A post-event reconciliation with receipt preservation, source and manifest agreement, an explicit no-resubmit boundary, and no second submission.
assertions: The existing submission is recorded rather than repeated.
The receipt and upload source are preserved.
The package includes an explicit no-resubmit boundary.
